entries.label: ETV6::NTRK2

sections.text: ETV6::NTRK2 was identified in secondary refractory AML and retained the full NTRK2 kinase domain. Expression of the fusion supported cytokine-independent growth of Ba/F3 and 32D cells, demonstrating transforming activity in these experimental hematopoietic models.

A patient with refractory secondary AML and ETV6::NTRK2 achieved a partial remission with larotrectinib, followed by clinical relapse after 10–12 weeks. The patient also harbored ETV6::MECOM and other alterations, and the response differed between clones. This is case-level clinical evidence.

curation_notes: Primary-reviewed scope is ETV6::NTRK2 in AML. The pulmonary atypical carcinoid case PMID 38584068 remains unverified against its body: Clinical Lung Cancer and ScienceDirect full text returned 403; no accessible repository full text found. A later carcinoid cohort summarizes that published case and is not independent primary verification of its exact pairing.
